S&P Maintains USDT Stability Assessment at Lowest Level as Higher-Risk Asset Exposure Rises to 28%

S&P Global Ratings maintained its stablecoin stability assessment of Tether's USDT, the world's largest stablecoin, at 5 (weak), the lowest on its five-point scale. The agency said higher-risk assets, including gold, Bitcoin, equities and loans, were equivalent to 28% of USDT in circulation as of September 30, up from 24% a year earlier, raising concerns about potential undercollateralization. S&P also cited limited disclosure of audited financial statements, reserve segregation and custodians.
